categories.name: 剧情与逻辑
categories.aspect: the plot, story coherence or storytelling
positive: The plot is coherent and makes sense.
The story is original and full of clever surprises.
negative: The plot has enormous logical holes.
The story is predictable and full of unresolved loose ends.

categories.name: 节奏与剪辑
positive: The pacing is brisk and the transitions are smooth.
The editing maintains an effective rhythm.
negative: The pacing is painfully slow and scenes drag on.
The editing is confusing and the cuts are abrupt.

categories.name: 演员表演与选角
positive: The actors deliver convincing and natural performances.
The lead actor is perfectly cast and deeply moving.
negative: The acting is wooden and unconvincing.
The lead actor is badly miscast and overacts every scene.

categories.name: 人物塑造
positive: The characters are complex with believable motivations.
The protagonist grows in a convincing way.
negative: The characters are flat and their motives make no sense.
The relationships are underdeveloped and the protagonist never grows.

categories.name: 对白与台词
positive: The dialogue is sharp and sounds natural.
The conversations reveal important details without excessive exposition.
negative: The dialogue is awkward and painfully artificial.
The conversations are repetitive and full of clumsy exposition.

categories.name: 画面与制作
categories.aspect: cinematography, visual effects, sets or costumes
positive: The cinematography is beautiful and the effects are convincing.
The sets and costumes are detailed and appropriate.
negative: The special effects look cheap and fake.
The cinematography is dull and the sets look flimsy.

categories.name: 配乐与声音
categories.aspect: music, soundtrack, sound effects or audio clarity
positive: The soundtrack fits each scene and the dialogue is clearly audible.
The music is memorable and supports the drama.
negative: The music is repetitive and drowns out the dialogue.
The sound effects are distorted and distracting.

categories.name: 情绪与类型效果
categories.aspect: emotional impact, humor, suspense or frightening atmosphere
positive: The jokes made me laugh and the suspense kept me on edge.
The emotional scenes moved me to tears and the horror was genuinely frightening.
negative: The jokes are painfully unfunny and the scares never work.
The emotional scenes feel forced and there is no suspense.

categories.name: 主题与表达
positive: The themes are thoughtful and the message is clear.
The ideas offer real depth and leave room for reflection.
negative: The message is shallow and excessively preachy.
The themes are muddled and the ideas lack depth.

categories.name: 改编与原作
categories.aspect: adaptation of an original book or other source material
positive: The adaptation captures the spirit of the original novel.
The changes from the book are thoughtful and effective.
negative: The adaptation destroys the original novel's spirit.
The changes from the book remove its most important scenes.

categories.name: 其他
categories.aspect: a concrete viewing issue outside story, pacing, acting, characters, dialogue, visuals, audio, emotional impact, themes and adaptation
positive: The subtitles are accurate and easy to read.
The DVD includes an informative commentary track.
negative: The subtitles are inaccurate and unreadable.
The disc repeatedly freezes during playback.
